text: After founder Igor Altushkin's exit on 14 June 2023, RMK's redomiciled parent company Russian Copper Company Limited is owned 34% by RMK president Vsevolod Levin, 33% by Roman Gorokhov, and 3% by Igor Kozhukhov, who also became the owner of Torivent Ventures Limited, holder of 30%.
short: RMK parent owned by Levin 34%, Gorokhov 33%, Kozhukhov 3% plus Torivent's 30% (Interfax).

source.name: Interfax: Алтушкин вышел из числа владельцев редомицилированной в РФ материнской компании РМК
source.note: Translation of quote: 'Since 14 June, Levin owns 34% of Russian Copper Company Limited; another 3% is owned by Igor Kozhukhov.' The same article states Roman Gorokhov holds 33% and that Kozhukhov became the new owner of Torivent Ventures Limited (30%).
source.quote: С 14 июня Левину в "Рашн Коппер Компани Лимитед" принадлежит 34%, еще 3% владеет Игорь Кожухов.
